summary: Retested the 3 Ex Libris PNG fixes. All 3 now pass. FIX#1 cold cache: a new person payload (random birth data, name TESTCold) returned 200 image/png in 8.2s, well under the 45s target. The short cache file /app/backend/cache/natal_ex_libris/{key}.txt was created (123 words). The warm call took 1.8s. FIX#2 glyphs: fontTools confirms ☽ and ↑ are only in NotoSansSymbols-1 and ☉ and ✁ only in NotoSansSymbols-2, matching the routing. Visual check of the rendered PNG: all 4 glyphs show, no empty boxes. FIX#3 mobile 390x844: document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 390. btn-pdf-natal and btn-ex-libris-png wrap below the H2 and stay inside the viewport. Regressions: the Rapports button (on mobile) and the Aperçu card button (on desktop) both download ex-libris-Camille.png (376584 bytes, PNG signature OK). The no-birth_date account: the card is hidden, and btn-ex-libris-png is disabled with cursor not-allowed. Pytest: 6/6 pass (401 x2, 405, 400 no birth_date, 200 + cache, new cold-cache test).

minor.issue: The prompt forces the text to end on an infinitive, so the paragraph ends with no final punctuation (e.g. '...apprend à durer, bâtir'). In the PNG it looks truncated. Add a final period or ellipsis in post-processing if the text has no closing punctuation.

The ☽ and ↑ glyphs (NotoSansSymbols-1) sit lower than the italic text baseline. Their vertical metrics differ from Symbols2 and Cormorant. Apply a per-font y-offset, or align with font.getbbox/anchor='ls'.

The justification splits the French non-breaking space before ':', so a line starts with ':' ('posture / : ton cœur'). Join ' :' / ' ;' / ' ?' / ' !' to the previous word (or use NBSP) before wrapping.

issues: btn-ex-libris-png keeps the label 'Télécharger l'Ex Libris à offrir' while disabled; btn-pdf-natal shows 'Données incomplètes' (inconsistent, carried over from iteration 90).
